Operations console for the Ada data platform

Inspect pipelines, monitor incidents, audit and recover — from anywhere. Built for SREs and platform engineers who need a fast, accessible view into a running platform.

Pipeline visibility

Incident response

Every action is logged to an immutable trail. Roll back state changes safely.
